parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name for component (class, function, variable, etc.)

parameters.name: imported_items
parameters.description: Specific items to import (for 'from X import Y' syntax)

parameters.name: alias
parameters.description: Alias for import (for 'import X as Y' syntax)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type annotation for variables, parameters, returns

parameters.name: class_name
parameters.description: Target class name for adding methods or fields

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: Function parameters as array of objects. Each object has 'name' and 'type' fields. Example: [{"name": "self", "type": "ClassName"}, {"name": "x", "type": "float"}]

parameters.name: operations
parameters.description: REQUIRED for add_function: Implementation logic as array of operation objects. Each object has 'type' (e.g. 'return') and 'value' (e.g. 'x + y') fields. Example: [{"type": "return", "value": "a + b"}]. Without this field, functions/methods will have empty bodies.

parameters.name: docstring
parameters.description: Docstring for classes, functions, or methods

parameters.name: base_classes
parameters.description: List of base class names for inheritance

parameters.name: is_constant
parameters.description: Whether a variable should be treated as a constant

critical_notes: INVALID ACTIONS: Only use actions listed in allowed_values. Actions like 'add_code' and 'add_method' do not exist.
METHODS: To add methods to a class, use 'add_function' with 'class_name' parameter specified.
OPERATIONS REQUIRED: add_function MUST include 'operations' array for implementation.
EMPTY METHODS: Without 'operations' field, generated functions/methods will have no implementation.
output_format: JSON metadata files stored in .meta/ directory with automatic dependency tracking
template:
**file_metadata**: Incremental metadata building
Action: {action}, Path: {path}, Operation: {operation}
notes: Supports incremental file building with small, focused operations
Local models can build files piece-by-piece within context limits
Each operation updates metadata immediately for immediate feedback
Files are stored as .meta/{path}.json relative to workspace root
